articleTitle: Research on Integrated Management System of Physical Education Course Information based on Spring MVC Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Spring MVC framework is based on the integration of Spring framework and MVC design pattern. It integrates and simplifies the traditional SSM framework and builds a lightweight Web development framework characterized by “request-response” mode, which has been widely used in the construction of Web systems. The Spring MVC framework truly implements the idea of “high cohesion, low coupling” in software engineering. It is suitable for team collaborative development according to the software life cycle process, improves the coupling between modules, and reduces development and maintenance costs. This paper constructs the request processing flow based on the Spring MVC framework, designs the functions of the integrated management system of physical education course information, proposes the physical education professional curriculum system, and completes all the basic work of software development.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Self-service Cultural Tourism Information Platform in the Mobile Information Age
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: With the deep integration of computer technology and mobile communication technology, human society has entered the mobile information age, and the new technology has promoted the transformation and upgrading of mobile tourism. Self-service cultural tourism information platform development uses new technologies such as mobile technology, cloud computing and the Internet to actively perceive tourism-related information with the help of portable terminal devices, putting tourism on the road to mobile informatization and improving the competitiveness of tourism. The platform is developed based on Cordova architecture, which is a better technical solution for the transformation from website application to mobile application; this paper designs a system use case consisting of 8 subsystems, with a loosely coupled structure between each subsystem, which can improve the development efficiency; the interface of tourist attraction information entry is designed to provide reference for other interface designs.

articleTitle: Decision Tree Algorithm in Computer Aided English Teaching Scoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the information management level of colleges and universities, more and more evaluation information is obtained through the online teaching evaluation system. The evaluation data and other college databases form a large database with rich information. Faced with these sources, university administrators not only pay attention to the evaluation results, but also pay attention to other information hidden behind the evaluation results. This article aims to study your application in the English computer-assisted scoring system based on the decision tree algorithm. Use ID3 algorithm to extract and analyze scoring data, export scoring data for judgment, create decision tree scoring rules to predict scoring levels, and analyze many related factors that affect scoring. In the analysis result, the absolute correctness rate of the decision tree under Example 50 is 88%, indicating that the customization effect is very good. It may be very interesting to explain the relationship between the many factors that affect English learning. It can not only help students understand the learning situation in the English classroom, but also help English teachers solve the problems in English teaching in a targeted manner, thereby improving the learning quality of English teachers and students' enthusiasm for learning English.

articleTitle: Development of a Robot with Various Interactive Methods Applied in Airport
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: This paper shows the process about how designed a robot with various interactive methods, which will help airport improve service of quality for various special passengers such as hearing impaired/visually impaired/impaired mobility. We design and develops robots with multi-interaction capabilities for the information needs of disabled passengers in airport. During the air travel, this robot can provide the ticket information and the notice about baggage check-in, security check and so on. The robot has a variety of information barrier-free interaction functions such as text, voice, vision, and gesture action, which can better provide services for kind of special passenger.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Internalization of Extrinsic Motivation in English Learning based on Artificial Intelligence Assisted Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The internalization of extrinsic motivation refers to an active learning process in which an individual transforms academic requirements into individual identification experience and self-regulation through the understanding of the importance of things and a higher sense of self-determination in learning. The learning motivation generated by external reinforcement is weak and short-lived. Only by internalizing the extrinsic learning motivation can students be interested in learning itself, forming a virtuous circle and a continuous dynamic system. This article focuses on the analysis and research on the strategies for internalizing students' extrinsic motivation for English learning.

articleTitle: Design of Teaching Mode Classification System Based on PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: In the context of the continuous development of Internet +, algorithms are constantly surpassing, and PSO-based algorithms are developing rapidly. PSO is a random heuristic optimization algorithm based on swarm intelligence. As a typical representative of swarm intelligence, PSO has the characteristics of simple principle, few parameters, fast convergence speed, and simple algorithm implementation. It has been proved to be an effective global optimization method, showing great potential. This paper studies the teaching mode classification system design based on the PSO algorithm, introduces the PSO algorithm and related content, expounds the teaching mode classification system design. The optimization of teaching mode classification system design based on POS algorithm must bring significant changes to teaching mode classification. After multiple data tests, the results show that the efficiency of the registration and login module, functional classification module and search module of the teaching mode analysis system has reached 88.12%, 92.03% and 95.02% respectively.

articleTitle: An Evolutionary Student-Advisor Bipartite Game Approach to Policy Analysis of Motivating Graduating Students to Stay
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: For cities with universities and colleges, retaining talents who graduate from these institutions is a concern for the local government. From an evolutionary game perspective, this paper explores motivating students to stay and work in the city after graduation. One entity of the game is the student, who chooses to stay or leave. The other entity is the advisor, who chooses to motivate the student actively or passively. The advisor actively working is supposed to be working harder and more biased towards the student who wants to stay. When a student stays, the government rewards both the student and advisor. We list five equilibria of the system and analyze their stability using Jacobian matrices. The results show two main scenarios acceptable for the government. The first scenario is where a proportion of students stay. The main factor in increasing the students staying at this stage is advisors. The harder the advisors actively work, and the more biased they are towards students who want to stay, the more students will stay. However, for winning all students, which is a phase transition to the second scenario, the government rewards play a dominant role. At this stage, the advisors' efforts no longer matter, while the government rewards must be greater than the payoff the students receive by going to other cities.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimal Allocation of Innovation and Entrepreneurship Education Resources based on User Interest Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Educational resources have always been the focus of the public. Improving the allocation of educational resources in schools is also the direction that relevant researchers pay attention to. It is also an important guarantee to promote the further development of domestic innovative and entrepreneurial colleges and universities and to integrate with the international community. Based on the traditional allocation of educational resources, this paper uses the user interest model to conduct in-depth research, so as to propose the optimal allocation of innovation and entrepreneurship educational resources, fundamentally change the current concept of educational resource allocation in colleges and universities, and also improve the allocation of some basic educational resources. This experiment uses the current popular user interest model for research, explores the problems of current educational resources, proposes a specific way of optimizing the allocation of educational resources, improves the problems existing between different educational resources, and enables the further development of education-related industries in my country. The experimental results show that the user interest model method should be used to deepen the reform. The data before the experiment are 0.17 and 0.35, respectively, while the values after the simulation experiment are 0.15 and 0.29. The innovation and entrepreneurship education resource allocation mechanism can improve the effectiveness of educational resource allocation. Ensure the optimization of the allocation of innovation and entrepreneurship education resources.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Image Target Recognition System of Tennis Sports based on CAMSHIFT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Moving target tracking technology is a big field in the field of computer vision. Due to its wide range of applications, more and more tracking algorithms are constantly being researched and promoted. This article focuses on the tennis remote sensing image target recognition system based on the CAMSHIFT algorithm. On the basis of the literature, it understands the related theories of the tennis remote sensing image target recognition and the CAMSHIFT algorithm, and then the tennis remote sensing image target recognition based on the CAMSHIFT algorithm the system is designed, and the designed system is tested through experiments. The test results show that the accuracy of the system designed in this paper is relatively high, and the average recognition accuracy is about 90%.

articleTitle: Optimization of Experimental Teaching System based on ACSI Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Based on the ACSI model, this paper constructs the latent variables such as perceived experimental teaching quality, perceived value of experimental teaching and experimental teaching satisfaction, establishes the satisfaction SEM model, and uses Amos to verify and analyze the data. The results verify the applicability of the model and the relationship between potential variables in the model.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Sports Training Remote Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Combining Internet of things (IoT) technology with sports training, developing an intelligent sports remote monitoring system to provide scientific sports training guidance for athletes can effectively prevent sports injuries and diseases. This study introduces the IoT technology and puts forward a design method of sports training remote monitoring system, which consists of basic information management module, health status evaluation module, sports injury and disease prediction module, and scientific fitness mode recommendation module. Through simulation test, the system has good pulse and heartbeat signal acquisition and measurement ability, and stable transmission performance, which is worthy of popularization and application in physical training.

articleTitle: Research on Cable Sampling Method based on Machine Vision Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the cable sampling method based on machine vision algorithm, including the development and application of machine vision, the image processing technology of cable sampling inspection system, and the research on cable quality detection algorithm. In this paper, the traditional cable measurement system is optimized and reconstructed, and an automatic cable measurement system based on machine vision is designed, so the research in this paper has a certain significance.

articleTitle: The Design of College Students' Innovation and Entrepreneurship Information Experience System based on Multidimensional Dynamic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the country needs a large number of innovative and entrepreneurial talents, and college students deserve to become the main force of innovation and entrepreneurship. Colleges and universities provide students with Double creation training, which helps to improve students' comprehensive quality and competitiveness. In today's Internet era, the power of the Internet must be used to make Double creation education more effective. At present, the student Double creation platform of colleges and universities lacks an information experience the system, analyzes the data of the system designs a college student Double creation information experience system, and conducts experiments on the system Performance Testing. The experimental results show that the system data is good and the operation is efficient; it shows that the system data calculated by the multi-dimensional dynamic algorithm is suitable for college students' Double creation experience.

articleTitle: Postgraduate Development Dynamic Early Warning of Improved Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: With the development of society and the in-depth advancement of higher education, postgraduates are facing increasing pressures in education, economy, work and psychology. To ensure the teaching quality of postgraduates and improve the development level of postgraduates, it is necessary to pay attention to their academic dynamics, and the academic development dynamics of postgraduates includes not only academic performance, but also the ability to take care of themselves. Whether there are deviations in study or life, the quality of postgraduate teaching will be greatly reduced. Therefore, this paper establishes a postgraduate early warning standard to supervise and manage the students' performance in the whole process, and uses the improved deep learning algorithm to analyze the students' academic credits, failed courses, skill certificates, and dormitory hygiene and psychological conditions in life. Health conditions and other related early warning data to obtain students' comprehensive credit scores, and analyze whether to make early warning management of students corresponding to the early warning signals.

articleTitle: Feature extraction and application of signal weak shock based on particle swarm optimization neural network development and verification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: When a gear fails, it will produce regular shock vibration. By detecting whether the signal contains fault shock, bearing state identification and fault diagnosis can be realized. Aiming at the detection of weak impact signal of gear fault and determination of true characteristic frequency, a method of signal weak impact feature extraction based on PSONN (Particle Swarm Optimization Neural Network) is proposed. On the basis of studying PSONN, training BPNN can greatly improve the convergence speed of the network and avoid falling into the local optimal solution. Through the simulation study of weak shock feature extraction in strong background signal and noise environment, it is proved that this method has good shock feature extraction ability. The effectiveness of this method is proved by the analysis results of measured gear tooth breaking signals.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Perception and Sensor Network Technology of Urban Traffic Based on Energy Tree Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Traffic information collection is the core subsystem of the intelligent transportation system and the basis of transportation applications. Collecting traffic flow data with higher temporal and spatial accuracy through advanced information technology, and combining it with micro-signal control system for control and induction, to balance the temporal and spatial distribution of traffic flow on the road network, is the key to solving the problem of urban traffic congestion. The establishment of a complete traffic perception system and its sensor network can effectively promote the integration of urban traffic informatization and industrialization, and accelerate the development of the transportation industry to a convenient, safe, efficient and economical comprehensive transportation system. Therefore, the realization technology research, performance evaluation research, and state optimization research of the perception system and its sensor network used in the traffic field have become the focus and difficulty in the field of traffic information acquisition in the future, and the research on such problems has important theoretical significance and Realistic guidance. Taking the holographic perception of urban traffic components as the research background, this paper deeply studies the perception system and its sensor network for obtaining traffic information, defines the related concepts of traffic intelligent perception, and proposes the general architecture and performance evaluation method of the perception system. The performance optimization algorithm at different levels is studied to optimize the performance of the perception system, and the realization technology of the traffic perception sensor network is developed.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Universal Service of Intelligent Gateway of Internet of Things in Power System Based on Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Based on edge computing technology and Docker container virtualization theory, this paper designs and implements the universal service function of the global IOT intelligent gateway in power system. First, the overall design method of the power intelligent gateway system is studied from the architecture design, service implementation method, and gateway and cloud collaboration method, etc., and then realize the general service in the edge computing service of the intelligent gateway of the power system. The service is realized through Python language and through Docker General service for container deployment. In order to solve the deficiencies of Docker in terms of interaction, a Docker application interaction architecture based on the MQTT protocol is proposed and implemented to improve the coordination and scalability of the microservice architecture.

articleTitle: Research on Treadmill Design based on Human-machine Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Based on the design concept of human-machine interaction added in the process of running, this paper proposes the design strategy of interactive treadmill. It is based on the research of fitness product design with domestic and foreign interactive design concept. It analyzes the treadmill on the market, carries out the idea of human-machine interaction, conducts innovative design from the appearance, structure and human-machine interaction mode of the treadmill, and completes the design practice of interactive treadmill. The interactive treadmill solves the problem of boring exercise and unsustainable running. Through this research and design practice, it puts forwards a new breakthrough to the appearance, structure and movement mode of the treadmill, and provides reference for the development, research and design activities in this field in the future.

articleTitle: Research on the Network Management System of Students' Art Works based on DB2 Database
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: DB2 is a distributed database solution from IBM with excellent parallelism, certified to ISO standards at the highest certification level, capable of running on all major platforms, distributing database and data loads across servers, and best suited to massive data processing. The DB2 database is used to store and manage a large number of artworks produced by art-related majors during their studies, to facilitate teachers' review and students' learning from each other, and to transform these works into priority educational resources. This paper analyses the DB2 database product components and carries out the conceptual logic design and logical structure design of the database based on DB2, reducing storage space usage, increasing access speed and laying the foundation for software development.

articleTitle: Development of Calculating Machine Intelligent Proofreading System Based on Phrase Translator Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: At present, there are various types of machine translation tools, but the translation accuracy is low. However, the current research mainly focuses on improving translation accuracy, lightweight translation products, good user experience, etc., but lacks some attention to translation quality control. Due to the influence of translators' translation ability and workload, the translated text contains a certain number of misspellings and inconsistencies with the original text. The evaluation of translation quality is mainly based on some subjective translation standards with different opinions, and is done manually by experts. With the development of society, this manual process has gradually become a major obstacle to translation activities, translation teaching and even translation research. There may be several consecutive sentence fragments in the corpus, which have short vocabularies and the same length. In this case, the alignment algorithm based on vocabulary is prone to errors. Based on the phrase translator model, this paper constructs a computer intelligent proofreading system to realize machine intelligent proofreading of computer translation.

articleTitle: Design of College English Teaching Computer Aided System based on DM Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: With the rapid development and popularization of computer technology, computer-aided teaching model has gradually become a mainstream and has been widely used in College English classroom. This paper mainly aims at the operation and maintenance of computer-aided system in College English teaching, and puts forward a method based on data mining (DM) technology. In daily communication, learners analyze and process the information they have learned, and establish the corresponding database. This paper first introduces the current situation of English Teaching in Colleges and universities (CAU), and then expounds how to use the big data platform to realize the functions of distance education resource management, query, statistics and retrieval. Finally, taking college English as the research object, a computer-aided system for College English teaching based on DM technology is designed. Through the performance test of the system, the test results show that the operation time and delay time of the system are maintained at about 2S, and the CPU occupancy rate is also about 2%. This shows that the system can meet the needs of users.

articleTitle: Auxiliary Teaching System for Basketball Shooting Training based on Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Due to the growing of current teaching theories and the information age, the use of cloud platform (CP) teaching resources is becoming more and more common and practical. Put the cloud platform resource courseware production into the basketball special teaching, and integrate the teaching text, audio and video, images and other elements together, which not only adapts to the development requirements of social humanism, but also enables students to watch teaching videos and enjoy training At the same time of the process, I naturally mastered the knowledge and skills. This paper designs an auxiliary teaching system (ATS) for basketball shooting training based on a CP. The experimental group and the control group are taught with auxiliary teaching system and traditional training mode respectively. The experimental results show that the number of successful shots of students using system teaching is significantly higher than that of traditional training. The number of goals scored in model teaching verifies the effectiveness of the teaching system in improving students' shooting skills.

articleTitle: Research on Business Data Management System of Cultural and Creative Product Design and Development based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Artificial intelligence algorithm is the technology with the fastest development and the most research and application value at present. Its effective application can improve human quality of life and reduce loss. The development of artificial intelligence technology will gradually break through barriers among industries and help the development of human individuals, industries and cultures. Firstly, this paper shows the significance of the application of artificial intelligence algorithm in cultural and creative industry, and introduces the application of artificial intelligence algorithm in cultural and creative industry with examples. Through the joint application of artificial intelligence and business intelligence, this paper studies the build of business data management system for cultural and creative product design and development based on artificial intelligence algorithm.

articleTitle: Operation Design of Comprehensive Scoring System for Classical Dance Training Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: In the teaching of Chinese classical dance, body rhyme teaching not only improves the training system of Chinese classical dance, perfectly unifies the training, creation and performance, but also makes the training of Chinese classical dance more standardized and diversified. This study first analyzes the importance and artistic characteristics of body rhyme teaching, then analyzes the influence of body rhyme teaching on the development of Chinese classical dance, then expounds the evaluation criteria of the comprehensive scoring system, and then discusses the comprehensive scoring system from four aspects: the establishment of the evaluation index dimension, the analysis and processing of the evaluation index, the weight ratio of the evaluation index dimension, the conversion of the evaluation index and the comprehensive calculation At last, the operation and application of the comprehensive scoring system are introduced.

articleTitle: Cluster Analysis of Students' Consumption Behavior Based on K-means++ Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The clustering effect quality of the classical Kmeans algorithm is very sensitive to the initialization of the clustering center. When different initial clustering centers are selected for clustering modeling, the obtained clustering effect is quite different. In order to obtain more stable clustering results, this paper uses the improved distributed K-means + + algorithm based on the K-means algorithm to cluster the consumption behavior of students' behavior data. The students are clustered into three categories, and the characteristics of the three groups of the clustering results are compared and analyzed. The experimental results show that it is feasible to use clustering eigenvalues such as consumption intensity and consumption frequency to assist school funding departments to carry out targeted poverty alleviation work. At the same time, it provides a solution for finding “hidden poor students” and finding “fake poor students”.

articleTitle: Semantic Mining and Sentiment Analysis of MOOCs Reviews with Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Reviews of the mooc platform are feedback from reviewers on their experience of using it, and these reviews are important to other learners as well as administrators of the mooc platform. This paper uses word frequency analysis and co-occurrence analysis to examine the concerns of Chinese university users about the mooc platform, and LDA thematic analysis and sentiment analysis to explore several key themes and sentiment situations in user reviews. The study found that users are generally satisfied with the mooc platform, but there are still some problems, such as unreasonable class or quiz times, lagging videos and no reminders of class times. This paper makes three recommendations based on the current problems and aims to provide strategies for the development of mooc.

articleTitle: Swarm Intelligence Algorithm in the Evaluation System of English Reading Teaching Quality
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The teaching of English reading in colleges and universities is a topic that both students and teachers are concerned about. To improve students' English proficiency, the quality of teaching must be improved. Therefore, it is necessary to establish a teaching quality evaluation system (TQES). The system evaluation method allows teachers to obtain relevant information in time through information feedback after the evaluation, find teachers' problems in the teaching process, adjust the teaching mode in time, continuously correct mistakes and deficiencies in the teaching process, improve grades, and raise the quality of teaching to a higher level. This paper introduces the swarm intelligence algorithm (SIA) when designing the English reading TQES, the purpose is to improve the calculation speed and accuracy of the scoring results, and verify the feasibility of the system by testing the performance of the system.

articleTitle: Automatic Test Scoring System Based on Deep Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The traditional examination papers generally use manual marking, which is a very time-consuming and inefficient marking method. If teachers manually correct students' examination papers every time, not only the workload is heavy, but also due to the influence of subjective factors, they will not be able to objectively and impartially reflect the students' learning effect. If automatic scoring can be realized, it will greatly reduce the workload of teachers, improve the accuracy and objectiveness of scoring, and thus improve the quality of teaching. Therefore, solving the automatic scoring of examination papers is a key problem that needs to be solved urgently at present. In this paper, the BP neural network model in the deep learning technology is used to establish an automatic examination scoring system, which optimizes the information management performance of the system.

articleTitle: Identification of Safety Factors for UAV Systems in Non-isolated Airspace
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: UAV and manned aircraft perform tasks together, or UAV perform tasks in formation, which will inevitably bring safety problems in the non-isolated air. In order to improve the safety level of the UAV system when performing tasks, a risk assessment method based on Monte-Carlo is proposed. Firstly, the unsafe causes of the UAV system are analyzed, and then combined with the ground impact model of the UAV system, the influence of air resistance is considered, and the uncertainty of each influencing factor is described separately. Finally, the X8 and Zenith ATX8 are selected. For typical unmanned aerial vehicles, Monte-Carlo simulation algorithm is used for risk assessment in three areas: low-risk area, general-risk area, and high-risk area, and sensitivity analysis of each influencing factor is carried out. The simulation shows that the slip angle of the UAV is the key factor affecting the allowable failure rate of the system; the same type of UAV flying in airspaces with different population densities contributes to the failure rate of the UAV differently. The contribution rate of the fall and glide angle is the largest; different types of UAVs flying in the same population density airspace have obvious differences in the sensitivity to risk, which provides the UAV system to enter the non-isolated airspace to improve the safety level of UAV a feasible idea.

articleTitle: Teaching Quality Evaluation System based on Optimal Neural Network and SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: When evaluating the quality of education, there are many factors that affect the quality of education, and the degree of influence of each factor is different. As a new technology, Neural Network (NN) and SVM can solve this problem very well. The purpose of this paper is to study the teaching quality (TQ) Evaluation System (ES) of optimized NN and SVM. Combining the actual characteristics of college training programs and the requirements of quality education curriculum development, this paper introduces optimized SVM and NN technology into quality education in colleges and universities (CAU). The implementation of this scheme processes the received data through SVM technology, realizes diagnosis and maintenance through the evaluation system, and obtains the final evaluation scores of teachers through technologies such as neural network optimization. The experimental data shows that the error similarity between the test sample error obtained by this system and the test sample error reaches 98%. It can be seen that the optimized NN and SVM TQ ES model proposed in this paper is a reasonable and feasible evaluation model.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-functional English Learning App Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: With the development of electronic information technology and the popularity of intelligent mobile devices, more and more mobile terminal Apps have been developed including many English learning Apps. This paper aims to design a multi-functional English learning App based on artificial intelligence. The App can use the database comparison technology to generate targeted knowledge points annotation, and has many other functions, such as intelligent selection according to the thesaurus, independent dubbing of videos, remembering words by watching news, and reminding users to review according to the forgetting curve. In this way, users' needs can be met to the maximum extent and English learning interest can be improved. The advantage of this App is that, with the help of artificial intelligence technology, it can obtain users' usage habits and recommend appropriate learning materials to users with different English levels according to their individual needs. It strives to make the software design more humanized, intelligent and easy to use in order to provide effective help for the user's English learning.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Big Data Information Processing Technology on English Oral Anxiety
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Language anxiety has an important impact on second language learning. Moderate anxiety can promote learning to a certain extent, but excessive anxiety will only make teaching results unsatisfactory. This article discusses how to use big data technology to promote the development of the latest teaching and research platform, the use of hierarchical group teaching, reasonable compilation of teaching materials, the development of scientific and reasonable assessment mechanism and other effective methods, to set up a real and vivid context for students to practice oral English, helping to alleviate anxiety, imperceptibly guiding students to develop oral communication habits, and establishing oral confidence.

articleTitle: Research on Computed Tomography Image Reconstruction Algorithm Based on Optical Flow Equation and Target Matching
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Image is the main source of human access to information. Due to the development needs of aerospace, biomedical engineering, industrial detection, culture and art, pattern recognition and military, image processing has attracted more and more attention, and has gradually developed into a promising new discipline. For different processing purposes, digital image processing can be divided into geometric processing, arithmetic processing Image coding, image enhancement, image restoration, image reconstruction, image segmentation and image analysis. Based on the adaptive image matching and tracking algorithm, a comprehensive algorithm combining particle prediction and template image update is studied to predict the position of nonlinear and non Gaussian problems. Aiming at the problem of large amount of calculation of the algorithm, an update combination method is adopted. Computed tomography technology is widely used in medical and industrial non destructive testing. Reconstruction algorithm is the core, and incomplete angle reconstruction is a hot and difficult problem in the research field of reconstruction algorithm in practical application This paper introduces the basic theoretical conclusions and common algorithms of sparse optimization. Then, the application of sparse optimization theory in image incomplete angle reconstruction is summarized, and its main research results and the role of sparse optimization are introduced; Finally, the research of incomplete angle reconstruction based on sparse optimization is prospected.

articleTitle: Application of Network Platform in English Education in the Information Age
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: At present, information age has penetrated into every corner of life, English teaching (ET), whether in vocabulary or grammar, has inevitably been greatly affected. However, ET under the background of information age has not been paid enough attention to, and has not been fully studied. The new idea and goal of educational reform in the information age is to realize the perfect integration of information technology (IT) and ET, to realize a new mode of teaching, that is, to learn from the essence of traditional ET. At the same time, with the help of multimedia teaching and digital teaching resources, a new ET model is formed to improve ET efficiency. This paper uses the literature research method and the questionnaire method, through the literature inquiry related material to carry on the careful reading, through the other researcher research result carries on the thorough analysis, and unifies the university ET actual situation to carry on the characteristic solution, expounds the university ET present situation and the characteristic, analyzes the network learning system to the English basic teaching influence, through the questionnaire carries on the data contrast (the survey altogether distributes 450 questionnaires, recovers 440, removes the unqualified questionnaire 25, the valid questionnaire 415, accounts for the total distribution questionnaire 92%), thus summarizes in the information age, the practical experience and successful cases of ET reform in colleges and universities network platform.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Evaluating Ecological Environment Quality Change Based on RSEI Model in the Golden Quadrangle Region in the Border of China, Myanmar, Thailand and Laos
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Since the 21st century, the urbanization process has been accelerating all over the world, and intense human activities have caused serious damage to the ecological environment. How to timely obtain the information of ecological quality and its changes to promote the sustainable development of human society is an urgent problem to be solved. The Landsat TM/ OLI images are used in the research area, and the remote sensing indicators such as greenness, humidity, dryness and heat are calculated based on the GEE platform, building remote sensing ecological index (RSEI), using the main component analysis method to conduct a scientific assessment of the eco environmental quality of 2000–2020 in Myanmar section of the Golden Quadrangle Region in the border of China, Myanmar, Thailand and Laos. The results show that the RSEI can better characterize the ecological environment quality of the region; The RSEI mean is 0.67 during 2000–2020, the overall ecological quality is in good level, showing a rising-falling-rising fluctuating trend; Ecological quality has obvious spatial heterogeneity in space, the ecological quality was the highest in the northeast, followed by the middle, and the lowest in the west and south. Using the RSEI model to realize regional ecological quality dynamic monitoring, it provides reference for the symbiotic governance goals, paths and criteria, and resource development and utilization of ecological environment governance of the Golden Quadrangle Region in the border of China, Myanmar, Thailand and Laos.

Author Keywords: The Golden Quadrangle Region in the border of China

articleTitle: Research on wind turbine fault monitoring and expert diagnosis system based on AR technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: This paper studies a fault monitoring and diagnosis method for wind turbines. After identifying the faults of the components in the wind turbine, aiming at the identified faults, the fault monitoring personnel can intuitively observe the faults of the components, which is not only conducive to taking effective fault handling measures before a minor fault evolves into a serious fault, thereby reducing the damage of the fault, but also reducing the experience requirements of the fault monitoring personnel, avoiding the fault monitoring personnel in the prior art relying on personnel experience. The process of analyzing the curve to identify whether a component has a fault.

articleTitle: The Research and Design of College Catering Information Service System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: In the Internet age, colleges have the highest penetration rate of smartphones. When the on-campus canteen is crowded, some students will choose to order takeaway. However, takeaway meals have many shortcomings in terms of food price, safety, and quality, and the entry of takeaway personnel into the campus will affect the safety of the campus to a certain extent. In view of this, this article starts from the analysis of the current situation of college catering services, points out a series of problems caused by poor management and service information and single traditional methods, and proposes the application of modern information technology to design college catering information service systems to improve dining environment and improve service level.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Intelligent Test Paper Generation for English Test Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Intelligent test paper generation is the core of online examinations, based on a test bank, which generates test papers efficiently and quickly through simple operations. Commonly used algorithms for intelligent test paper generation include randomised algorithms, back-testing methods and genetic algorithms. Simple randomized test paper generation method and backtracking algorithm have the disadvantage of too strong randomness, and it is difficult to ensure that the generated test papers meet the requirements. Using computer simulation and the problem solving process, with the characteristics of strong global optimization, overcomes the limitations of the traditional randomized test paper generation method and solves the problem of intelligent test paper generation in a scientific and reasonable way. The university English web-based examination system must continue to advance and needs to focus on solving the problem of intelligent test paper generation. The findings of this paper, which shorten the time used to extract test questions, are important in promoting English teaching reform.

articleTitle: English Education Software Assisted Teaching based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: In the era of big data, we should seize the opportunity, actively explore, and use good software to assist teaching. The combination of computer-assisted teaching methods and information technology has become a more popular teaching method in today's society. The purpose of this article to study English education software-assisted teaching is to improve the application of modern network technology and provide English learners with a better platform for English learning. This article mainly uses the questionnaire survey method and the interview method to analyze the students' attitude towards English education software-assisted teaching, and conducts relevant research on English education software through practical actions. The survey results found that 76.5% of people maintain an agreeable attitude towards educational software. This shows that most people are positive about the auxiliary teaching of software.

articleTitle: Data Storage Design of International Students Comprehensive Information Management System based on SqlServer Database
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: In the new era of continuous breakthroughs in technologies such as computers, big data, the Internet of Things and artificial intelligence, various new technologies have realized the ubiquitous and borderless sharing of information. In particular, the transition from the Internet to the mobile Internet has created a way of living, working and learning across time and space, and fundamentally changed the way of knowledge acquisition. Educational informatization promotes the development of international education, gives full play to the advantages of information technology, and develops a comprehensive information management system for international students to meet the needs of education management in the information age. Based on SqlServer database management system, this paper designs conceptual structure and logical structure, provides a complete data storage structure for the development of comprehensive information management system for international students, and solves the key problems of system development.

articleTitle: Research on marketing online micro-course system based on intelligent optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The close integration of information technology and education has made online micro-courses an important channel for disseminating educational knowledge. Blended education has gradually appeared in university education, and has gradually become an important tool for university education. The rapid development of information technology and the widespread use of mobile devices herald the completion of the construction of the digital campus. This article takes the intelligent optimization algorithm as a starting point, based on the relevant academic background, to carry out a unique marketing online micro-course research. The paper uses the literature analysis method to separate and analyse related concepts, and understand the concepts of intelligent optimization algorithms and online micro-courses. Summarizes its existing problems and explores the advantages of intelligent optimization algorithms, analyses the teaching status of the marketing online micro-course system, and summarizes the application principles and application strategies of the marketing online micro-course. Finally, the intelligent optimization algorithm is used to innovate the marketing online micro-course system, and it emphasizes that the marketing online micro-course system based on the intelligent optimization algorithm can increase students' classroom participation and improve the quality of marketing classrooms.

articleTitle: Construction of Monitoring System for Student Growth Evaluation under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Under the background of big data, the “Student-Centered” student growth evaluation system applies the concept of achievement oriented education, cooperates with the school to gradually form the OBE management mode, and constructs a comprehensive quality monitoring and analysis report system for the school from the quality of students, process quality to result quality. The results oriented quality monitoring system provides data support and management analysis report for the school's employment and enrollment plan, personnel training linkage mechanism and external assessment, and serves the evaluation, professional construction and certification of various types of colleges and universities. Through the continuous investigation of each student's performance and feelings in school, we can observe the development trend of students, understand the special problems of different grades, and feedback the process evaluation results to the teaching and training and student work, so as to help the school make continuous improvement.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Technology based Simulation Training System Research of Pan Business English Activities
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Business English proficiency makes great demand on an authentic and information-based environment, especially for non-native English speakers. Therefore, this study was conducted to develop a simulation training system based on virtual reality technology for Business English learners. Virtual Reality technology, characterized by immersion, interaction, inspiration, pertinence, dominance, and openness, can provide a comprehensive and superior training scene for practicing various Business English activities. Hence, this study explores the construction and operation of a virtual reality simulation training system for Pan Business English activities and the application of virtual reality technology in Pan Business English activities. To conclude, although virtual reality technology exploitation is still in the primary stage, the system can significantly improve the learning interest and effect of Business English practitioners.

articleTitle: Research on the production and application of virtual reality technology based on immersion and interaction in 3D animation scene
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Virtual reality technology has been continuously updated and developed in recent years, involving applications in various fields. The virtual reality technology is applied to the production of 3D animation scene, which not only retains the expressiveness of the scene, but also enhances the user's sense of immersion and interaction. This paper will analyze the feasibility and development prospect of the combination of virtual reality technology and 3D animation scene from three aspects: the advantages of virtual reality technology and 3D animation scene, specific case analysis and future development trend.

articleTitle: Design of Music Style Classification Teaching System based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: At present, computers have been widely used in various fields of social life, bringing many conveniences to people's production and life, and have become indispensable and important objects in people's lives. The BP neural network is a multi-layer neural network composed of an input layer, multiple hidden layers, and an output layer. It can connect neurons of different levels and connect them with weights based on their weights. The purpose of this article is to design a music style classification teaching system based on BP neural network. This article mainly uses BP neural network to construct a music style classification teaching system, and then designs a music style classification teaching system by improving the main melody extraction algorithm. The experimental results show that the test results of rock music are not very accurate. The recognition rates of other styles of music are dance 91.78%, folk music 87.24%, jazz 89.25%, lyrical 94.28% and classical 87.84%. The overall recognition rate is still relatively high. On the whole, the system designed in this paper can basically satisfy the use of music recognition.

articleTitle: Intelligent Manufacturing Training Base of Deep Integration of Production and Education Based on Genetic Optimization Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Genetic algorithm has powerful global search ability, which can be used to optimize neural network to improve algorithm performance. The genetic algorithm simulates the process of biological evolution, and goes through continuous reproduction and evolution from generation to generation to obtain the individual with the highest fitness. The demand for multi-disciplinary and inter-professional compound technical and skilled talents in intelligent manufacturing, intelligent control, multi-axis CNC machine tools, industrial robots, intelligent management and control platforms, cloud computing and big data is increasing day by day. Higher requirements are put forward for colleges and universities, especially vocational colleges and universities that focus on cultivating professional skills. It is necessary to strengthen the integration of production and education, school-enterprise cooperation, deepen the realization of a high degree of integration with relevant intelligent manufacturing enterprises, and complete the construction of intelligent manufacturing training bases with the help of enterprises. With the in-depth development of my country's industrial transformation and upgrading, the industry's demand for high-skilled talents has become more and more urgent, and the important position and role of vocational education has become more and more prominent. Through the application and practice of the training base, it is expected to be strengthened and supplemented in the aspects of teaching system, teaching practice resources, teachers'applied technical ability, and talent evaluation. However, the traditional genetic algorithm itself also has some problems such as local optimum and premature. To overcome the premature phenomenon and improve the local search ability, the genetic algorithm is improved, and then the improved algorithm is used to improve the performance of the genetic optimization neural network. In this paper, aiming at the genetic optimization neural network in the context of today's intelligent manufacturing, higher vocational schools should strengthen the integration of industry and education, improve the construction of training bases, and promote the comprehensive improvement of students'professional technology and skills, innovation ability and other abilities in the light of the needs of social development in the new era.

Author Keywords: Deep integration of industry and education

articleTitle: Evaluation Model of Teaching Quality based on Algorithm of Stepwise Regression Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The traditional AHP-based evaluation model of teacher teaching quality is unreasonable for the weight distribution of evaluation factors of teaching quality. The evaluation model of teacher teaching quality based on algorithm of stepwise regression analysis is constructed. According to the idea of the stepwise regression analysis, the correlation coefficient augmentation matrix, the calculation variance contribution, the proposed variables and the introduced variables are calculated. The key factors affecting the teaching quality are analyzed to find an effective way to improve the teaching quality. On this basis, the Logistic regression model is applied to classify the teaching quality and calculate the probability that teachers reach different levels to achieve the evaluation of teachers' teaching quality. The experimental results show that the constructed model can make rapid and accurate evaluation of the teaching quality of university teachers, and provides reference for the improvement of teachers' teaching quality.

articleTitle: Analysis of population and historical earthquakes in Guizhou Province based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Earthquake with the characteristics of sudden, unpredictability, instantaneous and induced secondary disasters has always been one of the most serious natural disasters, and population is an important disaster body. The intensity and frequency of earthquakes in Guizhou province are generally at the national middle level. To better meet the needs of disaster prevention work, the Guizhou population carrier spatial information and historical earthquake disaster attribute information, analyze the spatial pattern characteristics, grasp the risk factor information, not only can do the relevant information and data supplement, and the ongoing comprehensive disaster risk census work has certain data supporting role.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Laboratory Appointment Management System Based on RFID
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology is a non-contact automatic identification technology, which mainly refers to the use of electromagnetic propagation and space electromagnetic induction in communication, so that the marked object can be automatically identified. In this paper, aiming at the disadvantages of traditional university laboratory reservation management system. The management of open laboratory based on RFID technology is proposed. The design and implementation of the university laboratory reservation management system based on RFID technology effectively improves the management efficiency of the laboratory, reduces the labor intensity of the experimenters, optimizes the experimental teaching links between teachers and students, strengthens the real-time monitoring during the experiment, and further realizes the informationization, intelligence and automation of the laboratory management.

articleTitle: Realization and Simulation Analysis of Intelligent Data Fusion Algorithm Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Data fusion is the process of combining, correlating and combining the data and information of multi-sensor information sources to obtain more accurate position estimation and identity estimation, so as to realize the real-time and complete evaluation of the battlefield situation and threat and its importance. In this paper, combined with the artificial intelligence deep learning method, a classification and hierarchical data fusion method based on support vector machine is proposed. Support vector machine is a relatively new machine learning method. Because it is based on the structural risk minimization criterion, not only the empirical risk is minimized, so that the support vector classification method has a good generalization ability.

articleTitle: Design of Music Education Software APP based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The increasing development of the Internet has created new possibilities for people's learning methods. In the process of further improving the quality of national art and culture, APP online music teaching uses its unique educational form to provide music lovers with a new way of learning. And made a contribution to the development of music education in our country. In order to allow the majority of primary and secondary music teachers to actively change their teaching methods and improve their teaching quality under the guidance of new information technology environment and new curriculum concepts, this paper studies the design of music education software APP based on convolutional neural network, in order to design an online music education APP that can be used in music teaching activities. Firstly, the related concepts of convolutional neural network are introduced, and the design characteristics of music education APP are also analyzed, and its characteristics are fully applied to music teaching to realize the sharing of music information resources. Then the convolutional neural network is modeled for the design of music education APP, and the technical dimension indicators of music education APP are also set. In the final experiment, it was found that 78.4% of the students believed that the use of APP for music learning has cultivated interest in instrumental music learning and can greatly improve the enthusiasm for learning.

articleTitle: Research on Video Surveillance Violence Detection Technology Based on Deep Convolution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: In recent years, in order to continuously promote the construction of safe cities, security monitoring equipment has been widely used all over the country. How to use computer vision technology to realize effective intelligent analysis of violence in video surveillance is very important to maintain social stability and ensure people's life and property safety. Video surveillance system has been widely used because of its intuitive and convenient advantages. However, the existing video monitoring system has relatively single function, and generally only has the functions of monitoring video viewing, query and playback. In addition, relevant researchers pay less attention to the complex abnormal behavior of violence, and relevant research often ignores the differences between violent behaviors in different scenes. At present, there are two main problems in video abnormal behavior event detection: the video data of abnormal behavior is less and the definition of abnormal behavior in different scenes cannot be clearly distinguished. The main existing methods are to model normal behavior events first, and then define videos that do not conform to the normal model as abnormal, among which the learning method of video space-time feature representation based on deep learning shows a good prospect. In the face of massive surveillance videos, it is necessary to use deep learning to identify violent behaviors, so that the machine can learn to identify human actions, instead of manually monitoring camera images to complete the alarm of violent behaviors. Network training mainly uses video data set to identify network training.

articleTitle: Construction of Substation Global IOT System Based on Edge Gateway
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the application scheme of the edge gateway in the ubiquitous power Internet of Things (IoT)-aware layer-end devices and edge IoT agents, a substation global IoT system of the edge gateway is built, including the overall architecture, application framework and cloud collaborative design of the system, and key technologies such as new edge gateway technology, coordinated operation strategy and coordinated operation scenario examples are studied. The designed edge gateway can meet the unified access of multi-disciplinary and multi-type terminals. The edge gateway is the carrier and key link of “terminal data self-organization, terminal cloud business self-coordination”. Through case analysis, it is verified that the edge gateway runs reliably, and the design goal and operation requirements of substation global IOT are met.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining Technology of Data Fusion Information Entropy in Scientific and Technological Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: In today's world, a new round of technological and industrial revolutions have changed the economic structure and the pattern of international competition, and the formation of an international consensus has been promoted by scientific and technological means. In the process of reshaping the world's innovation landscape, China has become an important participant in global scientific and technological cooperation. This paper studies the data mining technology of data fusion information entropy and applies it to international scientific and technological cooperation to improve the level of cooperation in key areas where China has scientific and technological advantages or needs, which can enhance China's scientific, and technological discourse power and appeal. The main research content of this paper is the application research of data fusion combined with data mining technology in international scientific and technological cooperation. Taking the high-speed rail going global cooperation project as an example, the number of scientific and technical personnel in the cooperation project and the scope of professional disciplines designed by the project are analyzed. Among the number of scientific and technical personnel, the number of quality inspection technicians at home and abroad is the largest, accounting for 26.62% of the total team, indicating that the quality inspection technicians play an important role; in the distribution of disciplines, high-speed rail is involved. Design majors and engineering majors have the largest number of people, with 45 and 31 people respectively, indicating that in the future, similar cooperation projects should vigorously cultivate talents in engineering design technology.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for College Students' Employment Tendency Based on Machine Learning in a Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The employment difficulty of college students has become a hot topic of public concern, and the research on the employment tendency of college students is a topic that needs to be discussed in depth in the academic circle at this stage. Faced with a large number of student employment information, big data technology can be used to quickly process it. Therefore, this article takes college students from a certain university as the research object and analyzes the employment tendency of college students based on machine learning. It is found that a total of 79.67% of college students tend to work in enterprises. The number of boys willing to work in the provincial capital and above cities, small and medium cities, rural areas and other areas accounted for 32.31 %, 16.24%, and 3.09%, respectively, while the number of girls willing to work was 23.67%, 19.41<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and 5.28%, respectively. University students' expectations for employment the number of people willing to earn a monthly salary of 3500–5000 yuan is the largest. Based on these data, we will analyze the student's tendency towards employment unit, employment area, and employment salary.

articleTitle: Informatization-based Teaching Reform and Practice of International Finance Course under the Background of “Internet plus”
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: With the popularization and application of Internet technology in teaching and the exploration and practice of online teaching during the period of COVID-19, information-based teaching reform has become one of the effective ways to improve the teaching quality of colleges and universities. This paper analyzes the exploration and research on the information-based teaching reform of International Finance course in the Post-Epidemic Period by using the “Student-Centered Learning” (SCL) concept and relying on the superstar Learning platform. Such corresponding measures are put forward as deconstructing and reconstructing the course content, designing task with difficulty-oriented, integrating ideological and education into the reform, and building a “341” teaching system. The reform has resulted in significant effect. Firstly, students are more enthusiastic about learning. Secondly, curriculum construction is more complete. And thirdly, significant Demonstration effect is achieved.

articleTitle: Prediction of energy structure of three dimensional born clusters based on dynamic lattice optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Objective Cluster science is a very important research field in computational chemistry, and the prediction of the lowest energy structure of B40 and B45 has always been a difficult problem. However, the traditional technology can't predict the structure well, so it is necessary to use artificial intelligence technology for intelligent prediction. Different from the traditional iterative Schrodinger equation, this paper proposes an improved Lennard Jones model and uses computer algorithm to predict the global optimal structure. Methods Based on the L-J model, this paper introduces the improved L-J model, and uses the ejection method and dynamic lattice optimization algorithm to generate the initial configuration randomly. Results Compared with the traditional model, the improved L-J model was better, and the goodness of fit reached 97.3%. In addition, the predicted global optimal structure of B40 is hollow body, and the minimum energy is - 84475.5; The global optimal structure of B45 is sphere like, and the minimum energy is −136395. Conclusion Compared with the traditional L-J model, the model generated by artificial intelligence algorithm can better predict the lowest energy configuration of boron clusters, which is universal.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Personalized Precision Marketing System Based on Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Firstly, this paper introduces the characteristics of data mining (DM) technology and the research status of association rule mining, and describes how to implement the classical Apriori algorithm. Secondly, aiming at the defects of the classical association rule mining algorithm (Apriori algorithm) in DM, this paper discusses the optimization of association rules in DM, and gives an optimization algorithm based on segmentation. Using the improved Apriori algorithm to analyze the association rules, and design the system application business, so that enterprises can accurately locate customers through customized business and services, find customer needs, analyze customer behavior and evaluate customer value through data analysis, and then formulate targeted marketing strategies to meet the personalized needs of customers. So as to reduce its marketing cost. After testing and development, the effect is very ideal.

articleTitle: Research on the Strategy of Chinese Language Teaching System in Colleges and Universities based on the Background of VR Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The article takes VR technology overview as the starting point, analyzes that VR technology can give the real experience to the experiencer, manipulate the virtual environment in real time, and solve the teaching problems. Based on this, the article combines the current situation of teaching reform of Chinese language and literature majors in colleges and universities under the background of VR technology, determines that teaching objectives, teaching resources and teaching methods are affected by VR technology, and proposes corresponding teaching reform strategies, so as to provide reference for related workers.

articleTitle: Website Cluster Technology Based on Cloud Technology and B/S Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: At present, there are some defects in the construction of some university websites. With the development of network and the emergence of cloud technology, these problems can be effectively solved. By analyzing some problems existing in the current campus website construction of Anhui Sanlian University, this paper establishes a website cluster mode by using cloud technology and B/S architecture, and forms a website cluster system integrating several sub stations and master stations, so as to realize the centralized and standardized management and information resource sharing of the website, and improve the security and stability of the website. The practical application shows that this scheme can effectively solve the problems faced by some colleges and universities' digital campus, and has a wide application prospect.

articleTitle: MLP-based Analysis on Factors Influencing the Demotivation of College English Learning for Students of Medical Majors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: English as a Foreign Language (EFL) learners need strong motivation to stimulate their English learning activities. However, in recent years, the demotivation as a common phenomenon in the English learning process of college students, which brings difficulties to English learning and teaching, has caught huge attention in English teaching community. Different learners have different reasons for the demotivation. This study conducts a total of two rounds of questionnaire surveys on the students who take the “Medical English” course in medical colleges as the research objects. In the first-round interview, we obtain a preliminary understanding of the demotivation situation, screening four key aspects, i.e., teachers, teaching content, learners and learning environment. In the second-round interview, we perform a formal survey to investigate the detailed information in aforesaid aspects. Consequently, a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) neural network model, a decision tree, and a logistic regression model are established, and a combination of qualitative and quantitative research methods are used to investigate the influencing factors of learners' learning demotivation and underlying relationship between these factors.

articleTitle: English Abstract Writing Based on Natural Language Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Natural Language Generation has a very wide range of application, which can effectively reduce manual work. This paper introduces several text generation models, such as recurrent neural networks, long short-term memory Network, sequence-to-sequence (Seq2Seq) model etc. English Abstract writing is a new text generation task, which helps people write abstracts more effectively, but it still faces some challenges.
