articleTitle: Design of Data Mining Hybrid Teaching System based on Artificial Intelligence Era Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, artificial intelligence has been paid more and more attention, and artificial intelligence technology has become one of the most popular technologies. In this paper, artificial intelligence is used as the technical means to combine artificial intelligence with hybrid courses, and the plant landscape course is taken as an example. In the plant landscape course, Superstar is used as the online course platform, and students can learn at anytime and anywhere through mobile phones, ipads, computers and other electronic products. It also analyzes the online learning of students in all aspects. In short, artificial intelligence plays an important role in the reform of modern education and teaching.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Dance Network Resources Storage based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: In the era of cloud computing, the way of data computing has changed, and the data storage mode has also undergone tremendous changes. The functions of personal computers have changed, and complex data computing and storage operations are not required. The key technology of cloud storage applications is to combine software and storage devices, use application software to convert storage devices into storage services. Use cloud computing technology to build a storage, sharing and service platform for teaching resources, solve the problem of repeated construction of teaching resources, and provide a full range of services for teaching. This paper constructs the load balancing optimization scheduler process and mathematical model, designs the Hadoop-based cloud storage model and the core functions of the network resource storage system to meet the needs of online teaching in the mobile information age.

articleTitle: Design of Artificial Intelligence-based Multimedia Resource Search Service System for Preschool Education
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Under the conditions of modern society, if preschool educational institutions cannot effectively integrate network resources into the network, their development will be severely restricted. Similarly, if parents cannot effectively guarantee the preschool education resources they want, the preschool education level of the family cannot fully obtain the convenience of information-based education. This paper aims to study the design of artificial intelligence (AI)-based Multimedia Resource (MR) search service system for preschool education. This paper analyzes the overview of AI, the methods of AI algorithms and the impact of AI on education and teaching, and finally analyzes the types of MR. The empirical analysis results show that the performance of the traditional preschool education MR search service system has been greatly improved after the adoption of AI technology, and we conducted a survey and found that more than 81% of people felt that designing a preschool education MR search service system applying artificial intelligence algorithms, it is found that the design efficiency has become higher.

articleTitle: Research on Communication Technology and Routing Algorithm of Wireless Heterogeneous Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The goal of future communication technology is that anyone can communicate with anyone else in any way at any place and at any time. The existing network or because the coverage is not wide enough, or the bandwidth provided is not high, so that a single network can not meet the future communication needs. The mutual integration between heterogeneous networks with different coverage and service provision capabilities has become the inevitable trend of network development. With the acceleration of the pace of life, the standby state of communication terminal has a greater and greater impact on the selection of network. Therefore, a communication technology and routing algorithm based on wireless heterogeneous network are proposed. The algorithm defines three terminal standby modes, defines the network gravity judgment formula used to measure the network performance, and puts forward different network switching trigger strategies according to different standby modes, And it can prolong the standby time of the terminal, so as to ensure the user's communication experience.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of Online Teaching System for Audio Reading Based on Streaming Media Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Streaming media technology transmits an uninterrupted stream of information from the producer to the end user in real time, with the original video or audio stream data, split into many packets for transmission, constantly transcending the technical limitations of the receiving terminal and the transmission pipeline to fully realise the instantaneous transmission of high-definition audio symbols. Streaming media technology has made audio books available to a wider range of audiences, and more and more people are reading and learning anytime and anywhere via smart phones. The shape of education will change in a smarter and more connected direction. This paper investigates the structure of streaming media systems, AAC coding technology and the storage structure of audio reading files, laying the foundation for the development of an online teaching system for audio reading based on streaming media technology, and promoting the development of mobile audio reading platforms in a service-oriented, virtualized and intelligent development trend.

articleTitle: Research and Development of English Intelligent Proofreading System based on Modern Intelligent Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: With the continuous development of modern information technology, English learning methods and approaches are gradually diversified, especially the English electronic dictionary, which makes English learning easier. The quality of translation is an important criterion to measure the results of English interpret, which is mainly characterized by errors in translation characters or spelling, inconsistent expression, lexical and grammatical errors, etc. At present, the most advanced machine translation method, the so-called phrase-based model, is only limited to the mapping of small text blocks. Because language information is not explicitly used, it may be morphological, syntactic or semantic. This paper designs an English machine translation model based on modern intelligent recognition technology. Through the direct maximum entropy model, we can get the best combination of different features in complex English sentences, eliminate some structural ambiguities and improve the accuracy of English machine translation. Based on modern intelligent identification technology, this paper studies the development of English intelligent proofreading system, grasps the user's behavior data through behavior log, and optimizes the system. The software part of the system PP. adopts the computer intelligent proofreading method based on the improved phrase translation model to find the correct words to replace the words to be proofread and realize the intelligent proofreading of English interpret.

articleTitle: Construction of English-assisted Translation Learning System Based on Association Rules Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The educational goal of college English is to cultivate students' English application ability and improve cross-cultural communication awareness and communication ability. On the one hand, applying computer-assisted translation to translation teaching can stimulate students' learning motivation and make them form active discovery learning methods; on the other hand, it can extend students' classroom teaching, absorb more relevant knowledge and achieve the optimization of teaching. Under the background of information age, the main purpose of English-assisted translation learning system is to assist students to be more autonomous, personalized and flexible in learning English, so as to improve students' comprehensive English ability and cultural communication ability. Based on the association rule mining algorithm, this paper studies the effect of corpus-based English blended learning model. Combining massive open online courses and corpus-driven mixed teaching mode, this paper puts forward corresponding improved algorithms for the problems existing in current translation software, and constructs an English-assisted translation learning system based on association rule mining algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Taijiquan Learning System based on PHP+ MySQL
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: As a traditional Chinese martial arts event, Tai Chi (Also known as Taijiquan) has a unique cultural connotation and excellent fitness function. MySQL is currently the most commonly used relational database. PHP is an open source dynamic web development script language. Researching a Tai Chi learning system based on PHP+ MySQL is of great help to the promotion of Tai Chi. Based on this, this article will study the subject of the design and implementation of the Taijiquan learning system based on PHP+ MySQL. This article first understands the students' understanding of “Twenty-Four Simplified Taijiquan” through questionnaires, and then analyzes the functional requirements of the system, and then designs the functional structure of the Taijiquan learning system. This article uses PHP+ MySQL software, three-dimensional technology, etc. to design the functional modules of Tai Chi. Finally, this article examines the effectiveness of the system in Taijiquan learning from the students' perspective and the students' satisfaction with the system. The survey results show that the highest user satisfaction is the content selection of the system, accounting for 88.21%, reflecting that Taijiquan is a familiar and favorite martial arts event with a broad mass base; followed by the speed of the system, accounting for 82.93%. It shows that the system reacts in time and runs smoothly.

articleTitle: Research on the Promotion of Computer Network Teaching Mode by Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: With the continuous progress of social productivity, the continuous development of network, computer science and technology, the original meaningful design courses have a “qualitative” leap. The application of computers to design is a basic ability that every designer must master. This article uses the copy function to repair image damage such as spots, cracks, dirt, etc. Using SketchUp software's material, style, output and other processing and adjustment tools, the drawing work of the building's comprehensive environment and external environment can achieve the expected teaching effect. Some of the many three-dimensional objects made by using 3DMAX software are generated by two-dimensional pattern editing. This is generated by the application edit command. Familiar with the command to edit the points, segments, and lines of line patterns can edit and modify various types of two-dimensional patterns very well and quickly. In the two tests before and after the experimental class, the statistically calculated Z value of 1.94 is very close to the critical value of significant difference (1.96), which is a significant difference. The results show that the big data has certain promoting effect of the teaching pattern of computer aided design.

articleTitle: Prediction of Rural Investment and Construction Funds Based on Logistic Regression and Support Vector Machine Combination Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: This paper aims to apply logistics regression and support vector machine models to analyse a total of 14 years of data from 2006–2020 on rural areas in Beibu Gulf, Guangxi, China, to explore how to reasonably help large enterprises in the economic zone to formulate relevant poverty alleviation plans, and to provide suggestions and references for enterprises that want to build rural areas in Beibu Gulf. By collating data from the Guangxi Statistical Yearbook, this paper selects seven livelihood indicators for correlation analysis, predicts capital construction investment projects and new fixed assets in rural areas, and constructs a prediction model for investment in rural construction. Finally, the logistics regression model and the support vector machine model were used to make predictions respectively. In order to test the performance of the two models on this problem, three common regression model evaluation indicators, such as MAE and RMSE, are used to evaluate the two models. The results show that the support vector machine model has more advantages than the logistics regression model for this problem.

articleTitle: A real-time tracking algorithm for centerline extraction of high-power laser welding seam
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The accuracy of the real-time position movement of the laser welding head is the premise of the welding quality. The hardware of SUSAN operator is accelerated by FPGA, and the pipeline operation of inter-level data buffer, internal comparator and adder is designed. In order to reduce the amount of data transmission between layers and the number of internal parallel computing when hardware is accelerated, the template is used to roughly extract the image before Susan computing, which nearly doubles the execution speed of the algorithm and meets the needs of real-time detection.

articleTitle: Design of Remote Experiment Platform of Communication Principle Based on Wireless Data Transmission Development and Verification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The experiment of communication principle is the main teaching method to expand students' independent innovation ability and development. It is connected with the courses of signal and system and digital signal processing, which is of great significance to the establishment of students' whole knowledge system. This paper introduces a remote experiment platform of communication principle based on wireless data transmission. The platform is based on the architecture of client, server, virtual instrument. Students can log in to the experimental platform remotely through the campus network, and remotely operate the real experimental equipment, including generating various test signals, routing the signals to designated experimental modules, remotely collecting and analyzing experimental data, etc. The test results show that the platform can accurately and efficiently simulate the communication principle and hardware experiment, and realize the experimental teaching of virtual and real combination and network interaction.

articleTitle: Intelligent evaluation algorithm for matching degree of music lyrics and songs in complex noise scenes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: As a product of human emotional expression, music has become a part of people's life. At present, although music retrieval technology has been widely used, the traditional music retrieval technology still has some defects and deficiencies. For example, it is not based on the characteristics of music itself, and it takes a lot of manpower and time to label each song. More importantly, when users only remember the melody, The traditional retrieval system is helpless. In order to improve this problem, an intelligent evaluation algorithm of Ci and Qu matching degree based on sequence model is proposed, which comprehensively considers the emotion of Ci and Qu and the rhythm relationship between CI and Qu, so as to give a more accurate Ci and Qu evaluation method. Firstly, this paper analyzes the current research progress of music classification and detection, points out the defects of various music classification and detection models, then collects music classification and detection signals, introduces denoising technology to eliminate the noise, extracts features from the signals, and finally takes the features and music types as the input and output vectors of neural network respectively, The music classification and detection model is established through the training of neural network. Based on the open song and lyrics synchronization data set, a positive and negative example model of music emotion and rhythm is constructed, and the music is divided into segments based on this model; Further, the lyrics and melody segments are encoded by the lyrics encoder and melody encoder respectively, and the encoded lyrics and melody features with upper and lower context are input into the lyrics and melody matching decoder to analyze the feature relationship between lyrics and songs and judge the matching degree of lyrics and melody segments. The simulation results show that the intelligent evaluation algorithm of word and song matching degree based on sequence model can evaluate the degree of word and song matching more accurately than the simple emotion matching model, which verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of Curriculum Teaching Reform in Colleges and Universities in Post-epidemic Era
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: Affected by the epidemic situation of COVID-19, colleges and universities have adopted online teaching methods one after another, so teachers and students have the opportunity to experience the whole online teaching process. After the COVID-19 come to an end, online teaching will continue to have a corresponding impact on teachers' teaching and students' learning, and will also promote the deepening reform of online teaching. The combination of online and offline modes of instruction is bound to become the normalization mode of college curriculum teaching in the post-epidemic era. Taking the course “Fundamentals of Programming” as an example, this paper makes an attempt to implement “online and offline mixed” teaching, so as to study and practice the curriculum reform in the post-epidemic era.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Automatic and Orderly Distribution and Palletizing System for Hawthorn Strips
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: This paper designs an automatic control system for hawthorn strips automatic feeding, orderly distribution, and automatic packaging functions based on the research on the product characteristics of hawthorn strips. The paper mainly designed the hawthorn strip automatic replenishment bin, lifting bin, hawthorn strip separation mechanism, linear conveying, automatic powder and automatic grasping system. The control system and man-machine interface of the whole system are designed, programmed and realized. It solves the problems that hawthorn strips are difficult to achieve automatic packaging, manual sorting, low efficiency and error-prone, and improves production efficiency.

articleTitle: Construction and Verification of Academic Performance Early Warning Model based on PSO-XGBoost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of student academic early warning model, this paper improves the problems existing in feature selection and missing value processing, proposes a students' academic early warning model based on PSO-XGBoost algorithm, and verifies the effectiveness of the model by using the mining performance of the algorithm and a single algorithm in the data set of this paper.

articleTitle: Evolution of International Security Specifications for Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) technology and its application in the military field in recent years have attracted extensive attention from the public, policy and academic circles. However, there are different research paradigms and debates on AI international security theory and policy. In the process of exploring AI global security governance by the international community, it is difficult to effectively integrate the opinions of all parties and build consensus international norms. This study focuses on the multiple evolution of international security governance norms in the era of AI, and summarizes and analyzes the current relevant debates in combination with the cooperation and competition between China and the United States in the field of international security in AI. Combing and mining these debates can provide a new research direction and perspective for exploring the path of AI global governance.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Load Balancing Module of Substation Intelligent Gateway under Multi-service Access
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information System, Computing and Educational Technology (ICISCET)
abstract: The load balancing module of the multi-service access edge computing gateway of substation is designed. Based on the theory of software engineering, the analysis of module objectives and functional requirements, the overall design of system architecture and module functions, the realization of module functions and the testing of key functions are carried out respectively. The design is based on the node information collection module, the load calculation module and the load judgment module, and takes the scheduling module within the edge computing gateway node and the scheduling module between the edge computing gateway nodes as the core, realizing a complete control process from access management scheduling to load balancing, so that the workload of the edge computing gateway nodes in the region can be kept in the most balanced state. The test results show that the load balancing module of the substation multi service access edge computing gateway can judge the load of the currently accessed service terminal, complete the dynamic scheduling of the access association mode, make the association access always in the optimal state, and maintain the overall workload balance of the current intelligent gateway.
